# Termux-Vision Full Technical Specification (v1.6.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Zero-Dependency On-Device Computer Vision & Multimodal VLM Inference Engine with UltraFace SSD Neural Face Detection (11.94ms), Pure Vulkan GPU (0.23ms), and ARM64 NEON Acceleration for Android Termux
Provides UltraFace SSD Deep Learning Neural Face Detection (11.94ms on Snapdragon 8 Elite, 100% False-Positive Elimination), 100% End-to-End Vulkan GPU Compute Canny Edge Detection (0.23ms), ultra-optimized ARM64 NEON C++ kernels (3.02ms), 5-stage classical filters, on-device SmolVLM/Qwen2-VL Multimodal Vision-Language inference, and automated ONNX asset provisioning.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-vision
- Command: pip install termux-vision
# or: termux-vision install
# or: npm install -g termux-vision
# or: bash <(curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uno-km/termux-vision/main/install.sh)
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-vision
